mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 3-month rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 320 signals unexpected inflation, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross above 320 in the next 3 months, or 5-day forward returns are not negative when the threshold is triggered.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained simultaneous rise in both federal funds rates and GDP demand (GDPC1) indicates accommodative monetary policy and robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 do not move in tandem over the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are not positive despite the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high INDPRO (supply) and elevated UNRATE (labor), investors anticipate peak demand, leading to risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Late-cycle expansion regime conditions (INDPRO >105 and UNRATE >4%) are not met, or 20-day returns are not negative when the regime is active.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 3.5% signals improving labor market conditions, reducing risk premium pressures and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross below 3.5 in the next 3 months, or 20-day returns are not positive when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of strong GDP demand (GDPC1) and robust supply (INDPRO) signals economic strength, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO do not both rise over the 5-day horizon, or 5-day returns are not positive despite the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: Post-shock recovery with FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and UNRATE below 3% indicates monetary policy normalization and labor market loosening, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: post-shock recovery with FEDFUNDS >4.5% and UNRATE <3%
failure_condition: Post-shock recovery regime (FEDFUNDS >4.5% and UNRATE <3%) is not met, or 20-day returns are not positive when the regime is active.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (demand) and federal funds rates signals strong economic momentum and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and FEDFUNDS do not move in tandem over the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are not positive despite the interaction.
